description: This file contains unit tests for the AnySoftKeyboard project, specifically testing the behavior of saving words to the user dictionary, handling hints, and auto-adding words based on user interactions.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardDictionarySaveWordsTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of dictionary word saving, hint display, and auto-adding logic in the AnySoftKeyboard project.

methods.name: testAsksToAddToDictionaryWhenTouchingTypedUnknownWordAndAdds
methods.description: Tests that when a user touches an unknown word, the keyboard shows a hint, and upon adding, the word is saved to the dictionary.

methods.name: testAddToDictionaryHintDismissedWhenBackspace
methods.description: Verifies that the add-to-dictionary hint is dismissed when the user presses backspace.

methods.name: testAutoAddUnknownWordIfPickedFrequently
methods.description: Checks that a word is auto-added to the dictionary after being picked multiple times.

methods.name: testAutoAddUnknownWordIfAutoPickedAfterUndoCommit
methods.description: Ensures that a word is auto-added after multiple typing and undo actions, following a specific issue reference.
